entries.label: Employee home-office eligibility (CRA practical test)
entries.notes: Practical wording; the statutory gate is ITA s.8(1)(i) limited by s.8(13): principal place of employment duties, OR exclusive use + regular in-person client meetings.
entries.source_note: CRA T4044 Ch. 8 (Rev. 25; 2025-year guide, fetched 2026-09-29). 2026-year guide publishes late 2026 - re-check guide wording Jan 2027.
entries.value: Worked >50% of the time from home for at least 4 consecutive weeks; expenses directly work-related; nothing reimbursed by employer

entries.label: Employee home-office paperwork
entries.notes: T2200 is NOT submitted with the return; it is kept in case the CRA asks. T777 totals flow to line 22900.
entries.source_note: CRA T4044 'Forms included in this guide' + Ch. 8 (fetched 2026-09-29).
entries.value: T2200 Declaration of Conditions of Employment (signed by employer); T777 Statement of Employment Expenses (employee); claim on return line 22900

entries.label: Detailed method only from 2023
entries.notes: Temporary flat rate: $2/day, max $400 (2020) and $500 (2021, 2022); no T2200 required under it. Not available 2023+.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Expenses you can claim - Home office expenses for employees' page (fetched 2026-09-29).
entries.value: 2023 and later: detailed method only (T777/T2200); temporary flat rate ended after the 2022 tax year

entries.label: Eligible expenses: salaried employees
entries.notes: Rent only if the home is rented. Condo: only the utilities portion of condo fees.
entries.source_note: CRA T4044 Ch. 8 'What can you claim' (fetched 2026-09-29).
value: maintenance (minor repairs, cleaning supplies, light bulbs, paint)
employment use of basic cell phone service plan

entries.label: Extra eligible expenses: commission employees
entries.notes: Commission employees only; salaried employees cannot claim property tax or home insurance.
entries.source_note: CRA T4044 Ch. 8 'If you are a commission employee' (fetched 2026-09-29).
value: lease of equipment (cell phone, computer, laptop, tablet, fax machine)

entries.label: Never eligible for employees
entries.notes: Internet connection fees / modem-router lease excluded even though access fees are eligible. Equipment purchases vs leases distinction.
value: office equipment (printer, fax machine, calculator, briefcase, laptop case)
purchase of cell phone, computer, laptop, tablet, fax machine
computer accessories (monitor, mouse, keyboard, headset, microphone, speakers, webcam, router)
other electronics (television, smart speaker, voice assistant)
home Internet connection fees / modem-router lease portion

entries.label: Internet access vs connection distinction
entries.notes: Common filing error: the whole internet bill is not eligible - only the access-fee component.
entries.source_note: CRA T4044 Ch. 3 'Monthly home Internet access fees' note (fetched 2026-09-29).
entries.value: Include reasonable monthly home Internet ACCESS fees; cannot claim the portion of fees related to the lease of a modem/router or connection fees

entries.label: Employee no-loss cap + same-employer carryforward
entries.notes: Unused amounts carry forward indefinitely but die on a change of employer. Commission employees: non-vehicle commission expenses also cannot exceed commission income.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Expenses you can claim' page (fetched 2026-09-29); statutory base IT-352R2 archived (s.8(13)(c)).
entries.value: Work-space-in-the-home expenses cannot create or increase a loss from employment; unused amounts carry forward indefinitely, usable only in a year reporting income from the same employer

entries.label: Employee employment-use math
entries.notes: CRA examples: designated 14%-room on $11,200 expenses + $60 designated-space maintenance = $2,300; dining table 14% room x 40/168 hrs = 3.33%.
entries.source_note: CRA T4044 Ch. 8 'Calculating your work-space-in-the-home expenses' (fetched 2026-09-29).
entries.value: Designated room: allowable expenses x room% of home (no hours). Common area: allowable expenses x (area% x work hours / 168 per week). Multiple employees split the space; mixed employment+business use is split on a reasonable basis.

entries.label: Employee records retention
entries.notes: Vehicle log (date, destination, purpose, kms per trip) + odometer at beginning and end of year.
entries.value: Keep daily expense records, receipts, invoices, credit card statements, T2200, and vehicle logs for 6 years from end of tax year; do not send with return

entries.label: Self-employed gate and claim (s.18(12))
entries.notes: Loss cap uses amount 5D (T2125) / 5C (T2042, T2121). The wider menu (mortgage interest, property tax, insurance) is the main advantage over the employee route.
entries.source_note: CRA T4002 Ch. 3 'Line 9945 - Your share of the business-use-of-home expenses' (2025-year chapter text, fetched 2026-09-29).
entries.value: Gate: principal place of business, OR exclusive work use + regular continuous client meetings. Claim: T2125 business-use-of-home chart -> line 9945 (reported on lines 13500-14300). Eligible menu is wider than employees: mortgage INTEREST (never principal), property tax, home insurance, utilities, maintenance, rent share.

entries.label: Self-employed no-loss rule
entries.notes: Lesser of (prior carryforward + current-year expenses) vs net income; enter 0 at amount 7N if net is negative.
entries.value: Business-use-of-home expenses cannot create or increase a business loss; cannot exceed net business income before the home expenses; unused amounts carry forward indefinitely to a later profitable year under the same limit

entries.label: CCA on the home-office portion exposes home to capital gains
entries.value: Claiming capital cost allowance on the business-use portion of the home triggers capital-gain and recapture rules on that portion when the home is sold; the CRA administratively declines to apply the partial change-in-use rule to ancillary home-office use with no structural change ONLY while no CCA is claimed.
entries.notes: The expensive mistake to memorize: the CCA deduction is small, the future capital gain is not. Applies to both employee and self-employed routes.
entries.source_note: CRA T4002 Ch. 3 capital-gain/recapture note + Income Tax Folio S1-F3-C2 administrative position (fetched 2026-09-29).
